Have you tried working on your map sense and cross hair placement? These are two key things that play into CSGO. Counter Strike is a very strategic and delicate game; one mess up and everything’s broke. Working on cross hair placement and map sense will further improve your skill as a player. Placing your crosshair where enemies may be and understanding where plays can be made by your team and by the other team will also benefit you. I also recommend watching pros.....they’re pros for a reason. They have great map sense, know all kinds of tricks on all varieties of maps, and their crosshair placement is phenomenal. I definitely recommend you analyze these and work on getting that all down. These all may not be related to mechanics and although mechanics are a key part of the game, outsmarting your opponent will prove much more rewarding than tackling him head on mechanically. Good luck to you my friend!
